Composition_Info.Note: Used for atomistic molecular dynamics simulations of GB migration.

Process_Text.original: GB migration is driven by creating a free energy density jump across the GB. Simulations include oscillatory driving forces and cyclic thermal annealing.
Process_Text.simplified: 通过在晶界两侧产生自由能密度跃迁驱动迁移。模拟包括振荡驱动力和循环热退火。

Microstructure_Text.original: Nonsymmetric Sigma 27 [110] asymmetric tilt GB (ATGB). Contrast between symmetric and nonsymmetric structures.
Microstructure_Text.simplified: 非对称Σ27 [110] 倾斜晶界。对比了对称与非对称结构的棘轮行为。

Microstructure_Info.Note: GBs behave as Brownian ratchets exhibiting direction-dependent mobilities.

Properties_Info.Test_Condition: Positive vs Negative driving force direction
Properties_Info.Note: Direction-dependent mobility is observed in nearly all nonsymmetric GBs.

Properties_Info.Test_Condition: After multiple cycles of oscillatory force
Properties_Info.Note: Resulting from the rectifying effect of the Brownian ratchet mechanism.

Composition_Info.Note: Used for in situ experimental validation of simulation results.

Process_Text.original: In situ experimental observations of grain-coarsening behavior under cyclic annealing.
Process_Text.simplified: 循环退火下晶粒粗化行为的原位实验观察。

Properties_Info.Note: Experimental results corroborate simulation predictions of unidirectional GB motion.
